I was trying to purchase 4 Goodyear tires when I came across this website on Google. I saw they had a really good price on those tires, so I proceeded to buy them. At checkout, I entered my debit card information and pressed continue. Then a spinning circle with the word " processing " in it appeared. My bank sent me a code needed to go on with the purchase. At that point, I started becoming suspicious, so I checked my bank's website. To my unpleasant surprise, I saw an unauthorized transaction of $316.40 for JetBlue Airlines flight tickets. I called the bank right away to file a fraud dispute. The agent told me that I had to wait until the transaction posted so I could file a dispute. I called back on Monday the following week to file the dispute since the transaction had already been posted and my money had been taken for good. Unfortunately, and despite the irrefutable evidence of a scam, the bank hasn't credited that money back into my account. I have also file a report with the Joliet Police Department.
